mainEntity.name: How do you write a follow-up email after a meeting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Thank the attendees, restate decisions, list action items with owners and dates, and confirm the next step. Grammarly reckons 3 to 5 sentences carry most follow-ups, so a good example of a follow up email after a meeting rarely fills a screen. Put the decisions and actions in the first lines.

mainEntity.name: How long after a meeting should you send a follow-up email?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send it within 24 hours, and the same day for client and sales meetings. One exception: after a job interview, Grammarly suggests a thank-you within 24 hours and a second note only once the stated decision date has passed. For a sales sequence, 5 to 7 touches over 2 to 3 weeks is common.

mainEntity.name: What is a good subject line for a follow-up email after a meeting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Name the meeting and the content, such as "Recap and next steps from today's review" or "Team sync Oct 21: decisions and actions". Specific subject lines get opened. Why? People can see the email concerns them. Avoid a bare "Following up", which is easy to ignore in a busy inbox.

mainEntity.name: How do you follow up politely if there is no response?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wait 3 to 5 business days, then reply in the same thread and restate the one thing you need. Grammarly's advice is to add something new each time, such as a resource or a question, rather than resending the same message. Two or three follow-ups are standard before you switch channel.

mainEntity.name: Should a follow-up email include action items?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Action items with an owner and a due date are the most important part, because they turn the meeting into work. Without owners and dates, a recap is only a summary. Name 1 owner per task, even when a team shares the work, so someone is clearly accountable.

mainEntity.name: Can AI write follow-up emails after meetings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. AI meeting assistants such as Lynkk draft the recap from the meeting itself, with decisions and action items already filled in.
